info.title: HAG Brokers Mobile & Integration API
info.description: Authentication, public marketplace, company opportunity operations, RFQ offers, private negotiation messages and scoped company notifications. Native push, standalone media editing, payments and partner credentials are not yet API features. JSON request/response; UTC ISO 8601 timestamps; decimal money strings. Errors follow Laravel message/errors format. 120 requests/min/IP overall; login/register/reset 5/min/IP each, forgot/resend 3/min/IP each. Store Bearer secrets in OS secure storage. Render user content as text. Native bearer authentication only; cookie sessions are insufficient.

post.description: Company registration additionally requires company_name, phone, country_code. Creates a free workspace atomically. Individuals cannot publish as companies. Privileged identity fields are rejected. No payment is created.

30-day token. Replaces token with same device_name, retains up to 20 mobile devices. Platform admins cannot use this API. Correct platform administrator credentials receive 403 with error_code AUTH_ADMIN_WEB_ONLY; use the web dashboard. Wrong credentials never reveal account roles.
Generic message whether account exists. Email opens existing secure website password-reset screen; no native deep link required.

get.summary: Poll private JSON message feed without acknowledging read
get.description: after_id and before_id mutually exclusive. Default newest30, returned in ascending ID order. after_id fetches earliest newer messages; before_id fetches nearest older messages. has_more applies in requested direction. Keep cursor unchanged on empty response. No HTML. No implicit read. Pause polling in background; respect429.

get.summary: Public bilingual mobile presentation configuration
get.description: Read-only. No authentication. Returns data with version, app_name, welcome/home titles and bodies in ar/en, announcement_ar/en, welcome_enabled, show_marine, categories and same-origin public image URLs (or null). Settings never grant permissions, subscriptions or financial access. Missing/unreachable configuration must use bundled defaults. Refresh on foreground (at most once/minute) or pull to refresh.

put.description: Requires mobile:v1 bearer token and current password. New password 12-128 characters, confirmed and different. Keeps this token and revokes other API tokens. Does not grant company or admin access. Rate limit: 5/minute/IP.

get.summary: Search active shipping ports, 30 per page
get.description: Verified company owner/manager with an active mapped customer. Existing legacy customer accounts remain supported. No prices, margins, customer IDs or internal offers are returned. Private no-store responses.

get.summary: List company freight requests, default 20 and maximum 50 per page
get.description: Verified company owner/manager with an active mapped customer. Existing legacy customer accounts remain supported. No prices, margins, customer IDs or internal offers are returned. Private no-store responses.

post.summary: Submit sea freight requirements for HAG review
post.description: Not a booking or confirmed price. Server assigns the customer and reference. Same company/key and normalized payload return the existing request; changed payload with the same key returns 422. Client identity, price, status and assignment fields are prohibited. Requires additive freight_request_keys migration. No invoice, deal or payment is created.

get.summary: Read an owned company freight request
get.description: Verified company owner/manager with an active mapped customer. Existing legacy customer accounts remain supported. No prices, margins, customer IDs or internal offers are returned. Private no-store responses.

404.description: Not found or belongs to another customer

get.summary: Read current account identity and revision

put.summary: Edit current name and sign-in email
put.description: Current password required for email changes. Clears email verification, preserves current API token, revokes other API tokens, requests a fresh verification email. Customer/company/finance/contact snapshots are unchanged. Does not invalidate existing web sessions. 409 requires reloading; no silent stale overwrite. verification_requested indicates a request, not confirmed delivery.

422.description: Invalid or duplicate email, incorrect password or prohibited fields

get.summary: Read only the current user deletion request

post.summary: Submit password-confirmed account deletion review request
post.description: Returns status pending or reviewing and requested_at. Idempotent per user. A request does not delete or disable the account, revoke tokens or remove business records. Manual team fulfillment is separate; no automatic completion, deadline or retention period is claimed. Pending request visible in admin account center.

get.summary: Read a published legal document without authentication
get.description: Plain text, selected language; drafts are never returned. No documents are published by migration. Published versions, titles and bodies are controlled by verified administrators.

get.summary: Read device-level push availability and preferences
get.description: Verified active company owner/manager. Returns available, project_id and device binding/preferences. Never returns Expo token or server access token. No system permission prompt.

put.summary: Register opted-in physical device for current mobile session
put.description: Requires enabled server configuration, matching EAS project UUID, Expo token, locale, offers/messages preferences. Expo token stored encrypted with unique hash. Rebinding changes opaque binding and prevents old-account navigation. New/re-enabled binding excludes prior notification history.

get.summary: Resolve a notification tap after checking binding and business access
get.description: Returns only name room/offer and numeric id; no arbitrary navigation or URLs. Does not mark notification or messages as read. Stale, foreign, expired or ineligible bindings cannot resolve.
